The Olaplex Lab

Pop Up Mob brought the No.3+ campaign to life through The Olaplex Lab, transforming bond-building science into a high-performance, high-gloss experience that stepped out of the bottle and into a space designed to prove that science never looked so good.

BeautyMarch 2026NYC, New York + London, UK + Milan, Italy100% Experiential
The Story
NYC + London + Milan

Inside the Lab, No.3+ was put under the spotlight. Guests stepped in with custom lab glasses, scanned their strands at FitSkin stations to understand real damage levels, and examined hair through magnified lenses and tactile before-and-after comparisons, turning bond repair into something you could actually see and feel. At the data center, a custom-programmed OLAPLEX Pacman-style game translated the science of bond building into movement: guests navigated the screen repairing broken bonds, visually reinforcing how No.3+ works from the inside out. The Lab debuted in NYC with an exclusive VIP night before opening its doors wider, then traveled internationally, translating the concept into Space NK locations across the UK and Sephora Italy hair bars.
